subject: Data-handling warranty + retention carve-outs — training exclusion request
messages:
From: Rachel Liu <rachel.liu@finco.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Data-handling warranty + retention carve-outs — training exclusion request

Karthik —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. FinCo’s compliance team needs explicit written confirmation that Redwood will not use customer request/response content to train or improve any models (including internal tuning experiments) unless we give explicit, contract-level consent. A few specific items they asked us to confirm:

- Is customer traffic ever used to retrain base models or for downstream research/workshops?
- Are logs, debug snapshots, or backup archives ever ingested into internal datasets?
- What are default retention windows for request/response logs, KV caches, and snapshots for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private deployments?
- How do you handle legal holds/eDiscovery exports without triggering any training pipelines?

If you can share a signed attestation PDF and a retention matrix we can circulate to our legal team, that would expedite things. We may also request a short addendum to our contract.

Best,
Rachel Liu
Senior Security Manager, FinCo Payments
security@finco.com

Attachment: sample-POC-specs.pdf (referenced)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Liu <rachel.liu@finco.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data-handling warranty + retention carve-outs — training exclusion request

Hi Rachel —

Thanks — happy to make this explicit. Short answers up front: we do not use customer request/response content to train or fine-tune models unless the customer explicitly opts in via a contractual mechanism, and we keep logs/snapshots out of training/experiments by default. More detail below so your compliance team has specifics they can rely on.

1) Training / model use policy (high level)
- Default: Customer text, files, and responses submitted to Redwood are not added to model training corpora or research datasets.
- Opt-in: Customers may opt in to a labeled program that permits specific data to be used for model improvement; this is always a written, auditable agreement.
- Internal tuning: We may run synthetic or internally generated experiments to improve runtime performance; we do not seed those experiments with identifiable customer data unless explicitly authorized.

2) Logs, backups, and debug snapshots
- Request/response logs: Hosted API default retention is 30 days; Dedicated customers can configure retention down to 0 days or up to contractual maxima. Private deployments are under customer control.
- KV caches / ephemeral runtime state: Kept in-memory; persisted snapshots for debugging are only created when an engineer is triaged on a customer issue and then only with approval and an agreed TTL.
- Backups & snapshots: Nightly runtime backups are encrypted at rest. For Hosted, backups are retained for up to 90 days for operational recovery; for Dedicated we align with the customer’s retention policy.

3) Isolation from training pipelines
- We enforce separation at the pipeline level: logs/snapshots destined for OLAP or tooling are tagged and access-controlled; training datasets are assembled from explicitly approved sources and go through a separate ingest process with a second level of review.

4) Legal hold / eDiscovery
- We can produce exports for legal holds on a per-request basis. Exports are copied to a secure archive and are not reintroduced into any training or research flows. We can include chain-of-custody metadata in the export.

Next steps: I’ve attached our standard No-Training Attestation (PDF) and a retention matrix for Hosted/Dedicated/Private. If FinCo wants contractual language, Mina (cc’d) handles addenda and can propose wording and a DocuSign flow.

—
Karthik Iyer
Head of Sales (Security & Regulated Accounts)
Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-no-train-attestation.pdf, retention-matrix-2026.xlsx

From: Rachel Liu <rachel.liu@finco.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: FinCo Security Team <security@finco.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2026 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data-handling warranty + retention carve-outs — training exclusion request

Karthik —

Appreciate the rundown. A few follow-ups from our infra/compliance team:

- For Dedicated instances, can you confirm whether any internal monitoring telemetry (latency, memory traces, sampling of request metadata) is aggregated across customers for performance tuning? If yes, are payloads ever retained alongside traces?
- For Hosted, the 30-day default: is that configurable per API key/route, and can we request shorter windows while we finalize our procurement?
- We need to ensure the exported legal-hold copy will not be accidentally routed to any ML teams; can you describe the access control and file movement steps?

Also — our legal team asked whether Redwood already has a signed attestation we can rely on (not just a template). Is the attached attestation signed, or is it a sample?

Thanks —
Rachel

> On Tue, Jun 22, 2026 at 9:18 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com> wrote:
> > I’ve attached our standard No-Training Attestation (PDF) and a retention matrix for Hosted/Dedicated/Private. If FinCo wants contractual language, Mina (cc’d) handles addenda and can propose wording and a DocuSign flow.

From: Mina Haddad <mina@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Liu <rachel.liu@finco.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2026 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Data-handling warranty + retention carve-outs — training exclusion request

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the great questions. I’m the security lead who manages attestation and addenda for regulated customers — happy to coordinate the formal language. Answers below with the compliance-level detail your legal team expects.

1) Dedicated telemetry and aggregated metrics
- We collect operational telemetry (latency histograms, GPU utilization, error rates) for capacity planning. For Dedicated customers we run a tenant-isolated telemetry pipeline. Aggregation metrics do not include request/response content or PII. Any metadata fields used for performance debugging are pseudonymized and stored separately; payloads are not stored alongside aggregated traces.

2) Configurable retention windows
- Hosted: retention is configurable at the tenant level via an admin request during procurement; we can shorten the default 30-day window to as low as 7 days for the route(s) you specify while PR is completed.
- Dedicated: retention policy is set at contract time and can be set to customer-defined values (including immediate deletion).
- Private: fully customer-managed.

3) Legal hold / exports and access controls
- Exports are executed by our Compliance team and placed in a secure, access-controlled archive (S3 with strict IAM roles and encryption keys that are non-public).
- We add immutable metadata flags to exported bundles indicating the legal-hold status and mark the bundles as not available for ingestion into any ML or research pipelines. Engineering access to those archives requires a two-person review and explicit approval; we keep an audit trail of all accesses.

4) Attestation status & next steps
- The PDF attached earlier is a signed attestation from our Legal & Security teams (signatory: Laura Bennett, VP Legal). I’m attaching the DocuSign link here so we can execute an addendum with the exact deletion/retention TTLs you need: https://app.docusign.com/views/finish?doc=RWD-NoTrain-Addendum-2026
- If you’d like, we can also include a clause that explicitly prohibits the use of any exported legal-hold data in ML workflows; we will include chain-of-custody statements by default.

If FinCo sends one or two example clauses your legal team prefers, I can map them into Redwood’s standard addendum and we’ll circulate via DocuSign.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Head of Security & Privacy
Redwood Inference
mina@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: redwood-no-train-attestation-signed.pdf (signed), retention-matrix-2026.xlsx (annotated)
